gates.criterion_text: EDVI > 100 mL/m², EF < 40%, wall thickness < 12.28 mm.
gates.validation_note: Pipeline validation: ACDC's own 20 ground-truth-labelled DCM patients averaged EDVI 153.3 mL/m^2 and EF 18.4% (ground-truth masks) vs 155.7 mL/m^2 and 16.2% measured by this app's own segmentation model after manual QC/correction (n=10 of those 20) — both clearly past the >100 mL/m^2 / <40% cutoffs above, confirming agreement with the official ground truth. Wall thickness averaged 10.0mm (ground-truth masks, max 12.02mm) vs 11.0mm (system-derived, max 12.28mm) — both close to, and at the high end slightly past, Bernard's own <12mm bound, which is exactly why this gate's wall-thickness criterion above is widened to the union of all three sources rather than used as the paper's literal number alone (see _DCM_WALL_MM_MAX).

gates.validation_note: Pipeline validation: ACDC's own 20 ground-truth-labelled HCM patients averaged LVMI 92.2 g/m^2 and wall thickness 17.1 mm (ground-truth masks) vs 99.7 g/m^2 and 16.6 mm measured by this app's own segmentation model after manual QC/correction (n=10 of those 20) — confirming agreement with the official ground truth for this criterion. (The group AVERAGE LVMI sits below the >110 g/m^2 cutoff in both measurements — expected, since ACDC's HCM label is a clinical diagnosis and not every labelled patient individually clears every numeric ACDC criterion; this gate still evaluates each patient's own measurements, not the group average.)

diseasePatternGates.disclaimer: This is a research-based pattern-similarity screen, not a validated disease likelihood or a diagnosis. Each gate below reports only whether the available measurements meet a published classification criterion (primarily the ACDC Challenge dataset's own grouping rules) — meeting a gate does not confirm that condition, and not meeting any gate does not exclude disease. Interpretation by a qualified clinician, using the full clinical picture, is required.
diseasePatternGates.reference_source: Bernard O, Lalande A, Zotti C, et al. 'Deep Learning Techniques for Automatic MRI Cardiac Multi-Structures Segmentation and Diagnosis: Is the Problem Solved?' IEEE Trans Med Imaging. 2018;37(11):2514-2525 (doi:10.1109/TMI.2018.2837502), Section II.A.1 — the ACDC dataset's own defining paper, read directly, for MINF/DCM/HCM/ARV's criteria and NOR's own published numbers. NOR gate: union of this paper's NOR numbers; this project's own measurement of the ACDC Challenge training set's 20 ground-truth NOR patients (scripts/derive_acdc_reference_ranges.py); and this project's own deployed segmentation model's output after manual QC/correction, 10 NOR patients (scripts/derive_system_reference_ranges.js). DCM gate: same union rule applied to its wall-thickness bound only (EDVI/EF stay at the paper's own numbers) — the paper's <12mm widened to this project's own ACDC ground-truth DCM-group max (12.02mm) and system-derived DCM-group max (12.28mm), same two scripts as NOR. LVMI has no number in the paper, so its NOR/HCM literature component is still Zhan et al. 2024, Circulation: Cardiovascular Imaging 2024;17(2):e016090 (HCM: informational only, not gating — see module docstring). RV severity note: Kubler et al. 2021, Int J Cardiovasc Imaging 2021;37:2501-2515 (doi:10.1007/s10554-021-02280-6). RV PAH severity note: Humbert et al. 2023, Eur Respir J 2023;61:2200879 (2022 ESC/ERS PH Guidelines, Table 16, cMRI row). DCM/HCM reference-BSA fallback (used only when the patient's own BSA is missing): DuBois & DuBois 1916, Arch Intern Med 17:863-871.

rvRegionalHealthStatus.summary: Severe reduction in 1 basal RV region
rvRegionalHealthStatus.disclaimer: Advisory regional assessment, not a diagnosis. Unlike the LV, the RV has no validated strain reference range at ANY level — global or per-region. Thresholds here are borrowed from the LV's global strain reference purely as a conservative, consistently applied anchor, and must be interpreted by a qualified clinician alongside the full clinical picture. This layer never changes any LV grade and produces no RV grade of its own.
rvRegionalHealthStatus.method: Hybrid per-region classification: absolute GCS band (anchored on the LV's EACVI/ASE global peak-GCS reference, borrowed — not RV-validated) AND a relative gap versus the patient's own mean regional RV GCS.
